--- docs/feature-ideas.md (excerpt) ---
## Project Overview
PhaseTimer is a Vue 3 + TypeScript Progressive Web App for breaking down activities into timed phases. Originally designed to help occupational therapists work with neurodivergent individuals (ADHD, autism, sensory processing differences).

## Planned Features
### Phase-Specific Colors ⏳
Optional per-phase color for visual cues in the timer (red/orange for alerting, blue for calming). Inherits activity theme color when unset.
### Phase Transition Warning ⏳
Visual and optional audio alert N seconds before a phase ends, giving users advance notice for transitions — critical for the OT use case. Configurable per-user (0 to disable, 5–300 seconds).
### Push Notifications ⏳
Local (device) notifications for phase and activity completion when the app is backgrounded.
### Built-in Sound Library ⏳
8–12 curated, neurodivergent-friendly sounds for phase completion. Categories: meditation bells, soft chimes, nature sounds, gentle tones.
### Anonymous / Local-only Mode ⏳
Use the app without creating an account. Data stays on-device. Sign in later to sync.
### Internationalization ⏳
Multi-language support. Initial target languages: Spanish, Mandarin Chinese, Hindi.
### YouTube URL for Completion Sounds ⏳
Use a YouTube URL as a phase or activity completion sound.
